text:
7 guys dead in it. It burnt for 3 hours. I don't know whose helicopter it belonged to.
Trung Xi Nhat Nham is whose in the picture. He was protecting me. He was an interpreter and could speak 9 languages. He was a warrior monk. This is on Nui Ba Den.
